# Then get player-level effects relative to their team
player_foul_effects <- foul_binomial_model_vs_mo_2 %>%
  spread_draws(
    r_primary_defender[primary_defender,],
    r_primary_defender_modefender_foul_count[primary_defender,],
    simo_modefender_foul_count1[category]
  ) %>%
  # Calculate player-level effects for each foul count
  mutate(
    effect_0 = r_primary_defender,
    effect_1 = r_primary_defender + r_primary_defender_modefender_foul_count * simo_modefender_foul_count1[1],
    effect_2 = r_primary_defender + r_primary_defender_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2]),
    effect_3 = r_primary_defender + r_primary_defender_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3]),
    effect_4 = r_primary_defender + r_primary_defender_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[4]),
    effect_5 = r_primary_defender + r_primary_defender_modefender_foul_count * (simo_modefender_foul_count1[1] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[2] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[3] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[4] + simo_modefender_foul_count1[5])
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("effect_"),
    names_to = "foul_count",
    values_to = "player_effect"
  ) %>%
  mutate(foul_count = as.numeric(str_extract(foul_count, "\\d+"))) %>%
  left_join(defender_positions, by = "primary_defender") %>%
  group_by(defensive_team, primary_defender, foul_count) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_player_effect = mean(player_effect),
    lower_player_95 = quantile(player_effect, 0.025),
    upper_player_95 = quantile(player_effect, 0.975)
  )
